review.imagery: Root reviewed the full 36-spread index and all eight extracted scenes. Seven selected gallery entries use the phase-one front, courtyard, pool and published interior concepts. The later-phase closing park render on spread 33 is excluded. Recurring Nesba bedroom and Arada family-room scenes retain shared concept scope.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all 16 staged complete spreads and all 22 enlarged visible numeric panels. Fifteen choices contain every residence type, first–seventh building floors, the marked phase master and the community map. Final footer refinements include A2 879, B2 716, 2BR B2 1133, C2 1613, D2 1485, E2 1314, F1 1237, F2 1162, G2 1101 and 3BR A2 2151. Original sheets and physical-page links preserved.
review.location: Root reviewed the original red phase-one footprint, regional spread and community map. The community map prints 2/3/5/20-minute Zahia/University City/Sharjah-airport/Dubai-airport estimates. Entrance coordinates, exact distances and journey mode remain unavailable.
review.provenance: Normal GET of official category HTML and the 11,912,516-byte original June 2023 PDF retained dated URL, byte and SHA256 receipts. Source originals preserved. Canonical researched text, ownership, pagination and heroes unchanged.
